history.content: Hey, good to see you. What’s been going on today?
idk. not much. just kind of a rough day i guess
That sounds a bit rough. Is it more like tired, frustrated, or just weighed down?
weighed down i think. i had to ask my brother to cover my half of rent again. third time this year. i hate that hes the one who always has to bail me out
That sounds weighed down and maybe embarrassed or guilty too. What part of that hits hardest — needing the help, or that he keeps being the one to cover for you?
that hes younger than me and has his stuff together. makes me feel like a failure honestly. like im 31 and cant even cover rent
That sounds really heavy — like shame is sitting right on top of the money stress. Does it feel more like sinking, tight, or stuck?
yeah. stuck i guess. idk im not really good at this. think im gonna go. thanks tho
Yeah, stuck makes sense here. We can leave it there for now, and thanks for telling me.
